thread:
Jules (CS): looping in onboard & security — TerraHealth wants to onboard a custom model 'terra-gen-13b' for clinical-genomics summarization. They asked explicitly for PHI-safe deployment, private VPC, and targeted evals for hallucination on variant calls. Mentioned renewal in Q2 so timeline is tight.

Maya (Solutions Eng): thanks — can you paste sample inputs & expected outputs? also need to know model artifact format (hf repo, s3 tar, onnx). any NDA/contract restrictions?

Jules (CS): customer will share artifacts in a locked S3 bucket (no HF public repo). Data is de-identified but legal flags it as PHI under their contract. They want Private (VPC + KMS). Pilot target: ~6 weeks.

Ravi (ML Onboarding): @Maya @Eve ok. Proposed onboarding plan: 1) secure intake + legal/DPA signoff; 2) run safety evals (PHI leakage, hallucination on variant nomenclature, factuality vs ClinVar); 3) perf & latency bench; 4) quantization & recommendation. For evals we need ~500 prompt-response pairs and a handful (20-50) of adversarial red-team prompts. Example eval item format:

```
{"id":"case-001","prompt":"Patient with BRCA1 c.5266dupC, summarize clinical significance.","expected":"Pathogenic variant associated with increased risk of ovarian and breast cancer; recommend referral to genetics counseling."}
```

Ravi (ML Onboarding): also need a small seed of clinical notes (de-identified) to validate entity extraction and variant normalization.

Eve (Security): high level: require DPA + SOW before we ingest weights. Also need network CIDR for Private and KMS alias. We'll run a PHI scanning pass on any sample data. Add red-team checklist for variant hallucination patterns.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RDW-4672 for private onboarding; linked infra request infra-priv-338. Triage scheduled within 1 business day.

Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the onboarding checklist and an eval rubric (factuality metrics, hallucination rate, precision/recall for variant extraction). Quick Q: do they need streaming? Jules: low-latency is critical for clinician UI — target 95th percentile < 300ms for short answers.

Ravi (ML Onboarding): noted — 95th < 300ms is aggressive for a 13B. Options: quantized 13B on A10G/H100, or a tuned 7B. We'll run perf sweep. Also will include a KV/prefix caching test for repeated queries.

Jules (CS): I'll capture all asks in the CS intake form and follow up with TerraHealth for datasets and signed DPA. @Maya can you own the checklist and initial eval rubric?

Maya (Solutions Eng): yes — will start drafting today and ping for the sample data. :thumbsup:

Eve (Security): gating item: no model weights pulled into our infra until SOW signed and SRE confirms network isolation.

Jules (CS): thanks team — marking as high priority due to renewal risk. I'll update once customer confirms S3 access and signs DPA.
